title: Where your robot code goes
summary: Robot.java, teleopPeriodic, and how often it runs.

steps.title: Open Robot.java
steps.say: Everything you write this lesson lives in one file. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Robot` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find teleopPeriodic
steps.say: Your code goes inside one method. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `teleopPeriodic` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: teleopPeriodic
steps.say: `teleopPeriodic()` runs about **50 times a second** while the robot is enabled in teleop. Each time, it runs your lines top to bottom, so the robot keeps reacting to the sticks.

steps.title: The two objects
steps.say: Two objects are already made for you. You call methods on them.

board.code:
controller.getLeftY()          // how far the left stick is pushed
drive.setDutyCycles(0.5, 0.5)  // run both sides at half power

steps.title: Forward is negative
steps.say: Pushing a stick **forward** gives a negative number (that's how gamepads work), so you flip it with a minus sign.
